## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the checks that were run.

- [ ] Module changes were reviewed with the [Module design and release checklist](../docs/developer/module-design-checklist.md), or this PR does not change a Module.
- [ ] Upstream/runtime-asset changes completed the [Module upgrade checklist](../docs/developer/module-upgrade-checklist.md), or this PR is not a Module upgrade.

## Documentation checklist

- [ ] No documentation change is required, or affected documentation is included.
- [ ] Documentation follows [`docs/developer/documentation-standard.md`](../docs/developer/documentation-standard.md).
- [ ] User-facing changes update both Chinese and English pages.
- [ ] Commands and configuration examples match the current implementation.
- [ ] Current behavior, proposals, and historical records are clearly labeled.
- [ ] No secrets, private host details, or test-server logs are included.
- [ ] `npm run docs:build` passes.
